The incidents occurred while Russia carried out a major nighttime bombardment of neighbouring Ukraine. The development stoked tensions between Europe and Moscow just as the US is trying to add momentum to talks it is mediating on ending the war that...

items.t: ‘He’s a killer’: Zelensky on Putin after Trump calls Russian leader a ‘friend’
items.m: “For us he’s an enemy, and of course, for us, he is a killer,” Zelensky told CNN.

items.t: Top Democrat lawmaker threatens to block SpaceX's federal funding unless Ukraine Starshield slowdowns are explained: Report

items.t: ‘So what if there’s a hole? It hasn’t collapsed’: Kyiv residents unbothered by Russian attacks on city’s bridges
items.m: Despite dodging tears in the tarmac, people are confident in city’s infrastructure – and will not worry about what has not happened yet Mykola expects to drive his battered beige passenger minibus 20 to 24 times a day past the holes in the road on Kyiv’s damaged Northern Bridge that were caused by a Russian ballistic missile attack on Tuesday. Buses are now the only motor transport allowed across the normally busy multi-lane crossing, though on their way into the city centre they have to skirt the tears in the tarmac, using the only functioning lane to get by. items.t: Putin a 'killer,' Zelenskyy says after Trump calls Russian leader his 'friend'
items.m: It comes after Russian forces launched a major wave of strikes against Ukraine from Thursday night into Friday morning, killing at least seven people in Kyiv and damaging key bridges across the Dnipro River.

items.t: Russia dusts off its pre-war demands as the U.S. raises discussing European security at Ukraine talks
items.m: The proposal to discuss broader security arrangements for Europe was floated by Donald Trump’s envoys, and that has worried Ukraine and its Western allies, who fear it will play into Moscow’s hands and weaken NATO

items.t: Von der Leyen Condemns Russian Plot to Assassinate U.S.-Ukrainian in Denmark
items.m: "This was an attack on EU soil. And it is unacceptable," she said.

items.t: 'Unacceptable': EU chief condemns alleged Russian plot to kill US-Ukrainian citizen
items.m: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen condemned an alleged Russian intelligence plot to assassinate a US-Ukrainian citizen in Denmark, vowing full solidarity with Copenhagen.

items.t: Denmark accuses Russia of assassination plot, expels diplomat
items.m: Denmark has accused Moscow of being behind a failed assassination attempt targeting a Ukrainian-American rapper in Copenhagen, further escalating tensions between Europe and Russia. In response, Danish authorities have ordered the expulsion of a Russian diplomat and announced tighter restrictions on visas for Russian tourists. Yuka Royer reports.

items.t: Russian projectiles hit Poland as NATO tensions rise
items.m: Three Russian projectiles came down in Poland on Friday, prompting NATO to condemn what it called a grave violation of Polish airspace. A suspected jet-powered drone and a missile struck separate locations near the Ukrainian border, while another missile crashed just 35 kilometres from an area where European troops are taking part in military exercises. Meanwhile, troops from eight NATO countries are conducting drills in neighbouring Lithuania. With US-led peace talks yet to make a breakthrough, tensions between Europe and Russia remain high. Peter O’Brien reports.

items.t: From Crimea to Kyiv, Bridges Become Targets in Russia’s War on Ukraine
items.m: Ukraine’s destruction of the Crimean Bridge’s road span and Russia’s strikes on Kyiv’s bridges mark the latest stages of each side’s war strategy.

items.t: Back from Asia, Trump defends his close ties with Putin and Xi
items.m: In Washington on Friday, the American president praised the talks he held with his Russian and Chinese counterparts, especially regarding Ukraine. His account confirmed that the billionaire continues to chase illusions about a resolution to this conflict.

items.t: Military analyst Phillips O'Brien on Ukraine and Europe being left out of Trump's talks
items.m: As President Trump met with Russian and Chinese counterparts, Ukraine and its European allies were left out of the talks. NPR's Scott Simon talks with Phillips O'Brien of St. Andrew's University.

items.t: Trump Flaunts Camaraderie With Xi and Putin but Has Little to Show for It
items.m: President Trump called Russia’s leader his “friend” and marveled at China’s warm welcome for his first-ever trilateral summit. But there were no breakthroughs on nuclear control, the war in Ukraine or A.I.

items.t: Russian strike on Zelenskyy's hometown in central Ukraine kills 2, wounds 60
items.m: A Russian strike on the centre of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's hometown, Kryvyi Rih, killed two people and wounded 60 others, local officials said Saturday.
